title: fix(plugin-form): type the five form variants' child form nodes as FormSchema (objectui#11354)
body:
Fixes #11354
Clause-②: no

Parent: objectui#8347, the removal of `BaseSchema`'s index signature. The parent stays open; this PR is its `@object-ui/plugin-form` preparation unit. Session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01VhxTqosz7wn54ahqyxgERT`, dispatched by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217).

## What changed

`DrawerForm`, `ModalForm`, `SplitForm`, `TabbedForm` and `WizardForm` each build a child `form` node and hand it to `SchemaRenderer`. Each of the ten nodes is now a `FormSchema` const before it reaches `SchemaRenderer`. This is the shape `ObjectForm`'s flat path already uses (`const formSchema: FormSchema`). In `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm`, the shared base node is a `FormSchema` const too, and so is `ModalForm`'s shared column block. That way the keys the seven drawer and modal nodes take by spread are checked as well.

- No key is added, removed or renamed. Every value is unchanged; `as const` is dropped only where the annotation makes it redundant.
- No declaration changes. `FormSchema` already declares every key these nodes carry, so the Clause-② line is `no`.
- `WizardForm`'s step node is now built before the return, so its section-columns read is spelled `currentSection?.columns`, the spelling `stepGridColumns` already uses one line above. The node is still rendered in the same branch, and only there.

## Per-site verdicts: remedy 1 at all ten

| file | literals | key the P1 probe named | type tsc checked the literal against | what the child reads | remedy |
|---|--:|---|---|---|---|
| `DrawerForm.tsx` | 3 | `fields` | `BaseSchema`, via `SchemaRendererProps.schema` | the `form` renderer types its node `FormSchema` and destructures `fields` | 1: type the node as `FormSchema` |
| `ModalForm.tsx` | 4 | `fields` | same | same | 1 |
| `SplitForm.tsx`, `TabbedForm.tsx`, `WizardForm.tsx` | 1 each | `layout` | same | `FormSchema` declares `layout` (vertical or horizontal); the `form` renderer destructures it with a `vertical` default | 1 |

## The three hypotheses

- **H1, the population: held.** I re-derived it at `fd6f5da44`, a descendant of `17dc16793` (the ancestry check exits 0), with objectui#8347's P1 mutation applied. The result is 10 errors in each of this package's two programs. They are the card's ten literals: `fields` ×7 in drawer and modal, `layout` ×3 in split, tabbed and wizard. PR objectui#11351 moved line positions only.
- **H2, drawer and modal `fields`: held.** The literal sat in `SchemaRenderer`'s `schema` slot, which is typed `BaseSchema`, string, null or undefined. The `form` renderer types its node `FormSchema` and reads `fields`. The fix is the literal's type, by reference, with no declaration change.
- **H3, split, tabbed and wizard `layout`: its mechanism is falsified, and the remedy is H2's.** `layout` is declared on `FormSchema` and read by the `form` renderer.
  - Why `layout` was named: for each object literal, tsc reports the first undeclared key that comes after the literal's last spread, and then it stops.
  - What went unchecked: in these three literals, `objectName` and `fields` come before the `fieldContainerClass` spread, so tsc never checked them. `defaultValues`, `previousValues`, `submitLabel` and the rest come after `layout`, so tsc never reported them.
  - So the census's key column names one key per literal, not the literal's whole undeclared set. The defect is H2's.
  - A standalone probe reproduces the rule on tsc 6.0.3. One literal carries two undeclared keys before a spread and two after it. Exactly one error is reported: the first key after the spread.

The node is hoisted, rather than written inline with `satisfies FormSchema`, because `satisfies` does not fix it. The same probe shows that a `satisfies FormSchema` expression stays fresh in the `BaseSchema` slot and is still excess-checked against `BaseSchema`. That gives the identical TS2353 on `layout`. A hoisted, annotated const is checked against `FormSchema` and reaches the slot without freshness.

## Evidence

Every run below went through `os-verify-lock.sh`. The exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- **Control, with the signature present.** At `fd6f5da44`, `6ec220659` and `8950354c4`, `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` each exit 0 with 0 errors.
- **P1, with objectui#8347's mutation applied and `@object-ui/types` rebuilt** (the dist index-signature count goes from 2 to 1):
  - base `fd6f5da44`: 10 and 10 errors, exits 2 and 2;
  - `6ec220659`: 0 and 0 errors, exits 0 and 0;
  - final head `8950354c4`: 0 and 0 errors, exits 0 and 0.
- **Revert proof, after every P1 run.** Restored with `git checkout HEAD`. The restored `base.ts` blob equals the HEAD blob `ce2bc9e31`, and `git diff HEAD` on it is 0 bytes. `@object-ui/types` was rebuilt afterwards, and the dist index-signature count is back to 2. ⛔ The mutation was never committed.
- **One-shot reverse check, not kept.** At `6ec220659`, `ablation-replace.mjs` planted an undeclared key in two places: `SplitForm`'s hoisted node, after its spread, and `DrawerForm`'s base node.
  - With P1 applied: exit 2, 2 errors, both reading "does not exist in type 'FormSchema'".
  - With the signature present: 0 errors. The inherited index signature absorbs the key until objectui#8347 removes it.
  - Both files were restored to their HEAD blobs, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
  - My first attempt was a no-op. The tool refused it because the replacement text still contained the anchor, so the anchor count did not drop. I re-ran it with plants that do drop the anchor.
- **Published types.** I emitted declarations for the five files at HEAD and with the five files checked out at `fd6f5da44`. All five `.d.ts` are byte-identical. The only diagnostic in either run was TS5011, which asks for an explicit `rootDir` and affects output layout only.
- **Package type-check** (`pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form run type-check`, which echoes `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0 at `8950354c4`.
- **Package tests** (`pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-form/`, run from the repo root): exit 0 at `8950354c4`. 158 test files passed, and 1834 tests passed with 1 skipped.
- **Lint, narrowed to the five changed files** (`eslint --format json`):
  - The JSON lists 5 files, with 0 errors and the same warning count as at base, file by file: 21, 20, 9, 8 and 21.
  - The narrowing is sound because `eslint.config.js` configures no type-aware linting (no `projectService` and no `parserOptions.project`). So this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file.
- **Gates** at `8950354c4`. Each of these exits 0: `check-changeset-presence` (one empty-frontmatter changeset), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys` and `check:handler-key-reads`.

## Changeset

`.changeset/11354-plugin-form-literals.md` has empty frontmatter, which declares that no package is released. The rendered output, the props each component accepts, and the published `.d.ts` (measured above) do not move. A pending changeset, `.changeset/11168-object-form-layout-two-values.md`, names these files. Its claim that `layout` passes through unfolded, with an absent value drawn as `vertical`, stays true.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- **`layout: 'vertical'` on split, tabbed and wizard** equals the `form` renderer's own default. I kept it, as the dispatch's H3 instruction requires: the key is read and declared, so it is typed.
- **For the census owner.** A TS2353 count counts literals, not keys. A literal with a spread can hide more undeclared keys than its census row names, both before the spread and after the first reported key. The sibling preparation units objectui#11347, #11348, #11349 and #11355 read the same census.
  - class: none (a reading about the instrument, not a defect).
  - carrier: the `domain:spec` seat, as the owner of objectui#8347's census.
- **Remaining inline literals.** `DrawerForm` and `ModalForm` each still pass an inline `schema` literal to `MasterDetailForm`. It is typed by that component's own props, not by `BaseSchema`, and the P1 probe reports nothing there. It is out of scope.

## Not run locally

These are declared to CI: the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, the full `pnpm test`, `type-check:e2e`, and the doc gates (`check:doc-examples`, `check:doc-snippets`, `check:doc-types`). This diff touches no `@example` block and no doc.
